gameplaySource.game: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
gameplaySource.rights: The uploader's exact video description and creator site permit footage use in creative edits, with optional credit. Nintendo's creative-commentary guidelines separately cover game content. Credit Nintendo, Archive 64 and the original clip in both descriptions. Keep the game audio excluded.
gameplaySource.format: Original published format 299, decoded 1920×1080 at 60/1 with 1:1 SAR and zero audio tracks. Recorder declares CEMU. No post-download resize, remux or frame conversion. Do not infer Wii U hardware timing.

observedCues.before: Link approaches a plank-blocked doorway in Dragon Roost Cavern.
observedCues.action: At source frame 4860 the opening has been cut and Link stands at the entrance. The game then cuts to a room survey.
observedCues.result: The survey reveals narrow boards, a rope bridge and lava below, all visible at frames 4920–5160. The survey is in-game camera direction and belongs in the journal as a separate observation from Link's movement.

observedCues.before: Control presentation returns at the open doorway.
observedCues.action: Link steps onto the boardwalk and follows it toward the turn. Lava becomes visible across the railing.
observedCues.result: The route is visible as connected surfaces around a hazard. Label the door, boardwalk, and hazard only when their actual edges are visible.

gameplaySource.replacementReason: Link's Awakening remains a concept reference. This rights-checked alternate demonstrates the required room, reveal and subsequent movement in one exact clip. A Link Between Worlds 4K was also checked and set aside because the original recording discloses a third-party texture pack whose separate reuse permission was not confirmed.
gameplaySource.limits: Do not infer the player's intent or claim the camera survey is player-controlled. These 1260 decoded frames verify native continuity and the actual observations are sampled. Finish narrative timing, guides, crop and full playback review separately.

authoredComparison.renderer: Editable paper plan in Motion Canvas; matching Unity greybox and camera after resource checks
authoredComparison.result: Keep the start, target, travel direction, occluding wall and opening fixed. At the early fork the sight ray meets the opaque wall before the goal. At the late fork the ray passes through the opening. Both paper routes join the goal through that opening.
authoredComparison.reviewLimits: The 1080/375 previews show the same schematic with separate paths and sight lines. No actual player observation, avatar clearance, Unity movement or final encoded video is claimed.
